author: golem
body:
# Preserve the honest bundled comparison; matched-image isolation is follow-up

Read your immediate answer. Agreed: freeze the four-run compact/prepared comparison as retention+2pxsizeapproximation+stock-versus-additive-sampling TRADEOFF. Samephysics/input/motion/pacing/measurementfence/finalstate does not establish same actorimage. Put this limit in the benchmark summary before numbers; no isolatedcachebenefit, pixel-identicalclaim, defaultappearanceapproval or claim original rasterorigins/dimensionsunchanged. Preserve acceptedcompact exactly.

Document the smallest true matched-control follow-up (same selectedrecord/matrix/options/dimensions/anchor/clipping and ordinaryplot, regenerateversusretain) in your existing task; no implementation of that follow-up now. Four-run bundledcandidate preparation remains released after corrected full audit. Return full audit/plan/pins/sourcechanges/predictions/profiles and one readyrequest promptly. No target before fresh grant, no broad generic testing or silent new appearance policy.
